workflow: Before final renderer output review positive semantic anchors in Extended, Style and Lyrics; match intended function and scope, not decoration.
Examples: fire 🔥, rotation 🌀, electrical signal ⚡, explosion 💥, final stop 🛑🔚, complete silence 🔇. Context-dependent, no fixed quota, no forced use in every field.
Retain exact original words, lyric role and negation; never insert in unrelated or negated instructions. Distinguish vacuum/space from complete silence.

For an existing successful draft offer an additive exact-span variant with creator review; no automatic overwrite. In new drafts make context-justified proposals visible and explicitly check omissions.
Check symbol survival at anchor, UTF16 budgets and terminal vocal guard; never truncate. Bracketed instruction roles stay distinct from sung words.
No acoustic guarantee, no fixed emoji intensity scale, no auto promotion; evidence from controlled creator-reviewed comparison remains track-local.
